newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE CASH SOYBEANS SWING LOW WITH CHICAGO.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE CASH SOYBEANS SWING LOW WITH CHICAGO.

text.p: Argentine soybeans swung sharply lower Thursday after Wednesday's strong gains, in thin trading on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, dealers said.

After Chicago soybeans registered sharp losses in reaction to rain forecasts, Argentine beans slammed into reverse with spot down $5 a tonne and May off $3. New crop sunseeds fell $2 in their wake, but spot sunseed rose $1 on crusher demand.
Spot maize and new crop both dropped $1 to $2 in line with soybeans, while wheat was a little firmer, with gains of $2 a tonne for spot, on European weather worries.
